ToLoadCsvFileAsDataTable: to load a csv file as a native datatable
ToLoadCsvUrlAsDataTable: to download a csv url as a native datatable
ToGetDataTableSchemaJson: to get native datatable schema json
ToPreviewDataTablePage: to preview a native datatable page

ActionSignatures.ToPreviewDataTablePage: ToPreviewDataTablePage.Execute(table: DataTable, offset: Int32, limit: Int32) : String

ActionDescriptions.ToDescribeDataTable:
to describe a native datatable
table - native DataTable reference. Returns compact schema/count JSON without full rows.
ActionDescriptions.ToFilterDataTableRows:
to filter native datatable rows
table - native DataTable reference. filtersJson - JSON array of filter specs using PascalCase properties, for example [{""Column"":""title"",""Operator"":""Contains"",""Value"":""FairPath""}]. Operators: Equals, NotEquals, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, GreaterThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThan, LessThanOrEqual, IsNull, IsNotNull. Multiple filters are ANDed. Returns a native DataTable reference.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetDataTableSchemaJson:
to get native datatable schema json
table - native DataTable reference. Returns schema JSON without full rows.
ActionDescriptions.ToLoadCsvFileAsDataTable:
to load a csv file as a native datatable
path - disk path to a CSV file. Returns a native DataTable reference for typed chaining.
ActionDescriptions.ToLoadCsvUrlAsDataTable:
to download a csv url as a native datatable
url - CSV URL to download directly into memory. Returns a native DataTable reference for typed chaining.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewDataTable:
to preview a native datatable
table - native DataTable reference. maxRows - maximum preview rows. Returns ProtoScriptPreviewGrid JSON text.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewDataTablePage:
to preview a native datatable page
table - native DataTable reference. offset - zero-based row offset. limit - page size. Returns ProtoScriptPreviewGrid JSON text for that page.
ActionDescriptions.ToSelectDataTableColumns:
to select native datatable columns
table - native DataTable reference. columnsJson - JSON string array of exact column names, for example [""source"",""title"",""meetingDate""]. Returns a native DataTable reference.
ActionDescriptions.ToSortDataTableRows:
to sort native datatable rows
table - native DataTable reference. sortJson - JSON array of sort specs using PascalCase properties, for example [{""Column"":""meetingDate"",""Direction"":""Descending""},{""Column"":""title"",""Direction"":""Ascending""}]. Direction must be Ascending or Descending. Multiple sort items are applied in order. Returns a native DataTable reference.
